purpose: Record the first physical verdict from the dedicated one-shot counter-0 selector-6 pairing state machine.

second_gesture.reason: the first stage-0 rejection had already failed and disarmed the one-shot session

continuous_iq_trial.gesture: ordinary long press after the node and SDR capture were both proven armed

interpretation: The first trial is an unambiguous stage-0 rejection: the node claimed counter 0 and transmitted one assignment, but the valve emitted no addressed stage-1 request before counter 2.
The second physical gesture is not an independent pairing result because probe .19 intentionally disarms after stage-0 rejection.
The later continuous-IQ trial independently reproduced the same stage-0 rejection and captured the local assignment on air.

The stock and local factory carriers differ by only 31 Hz, while the local assignment is 9.979 kHz above the measured stock assignment; this rules out SDR drift and identifies reuse of the HTV405 initial center as the leading cause.

Assignment deviation and decoded structure match stock. Probe .20 therefore changes only the HTV145 selector-6 initial center by -9.979 kHz; timing remains frozen until that carrier-only hypothesis is tested.
